Messages.Author: Joshua Duffin
Messages.Body:
The Obeah versions of Resurrection do not appear to require the
burned ally or retainer to be in *your* ash heap. The Valeren
version, on the other hand, seems to assume that the ally/retainer
is in your own ash heap: "Move the retainer or ally card from
your ash heap to your hand" where Obeah has "Move the retainer
card from its Methuselah's ash heap [...]".

My question: Can you indeed take an ally or retainer from another
Methuselah's ash heap, playing Resurrection with Obeah? What
about Valeren?

(if so, it certainly answers the question of "what makes this
interesting compared to Compel the Spirit"...)

thanks,

Josh

Yes.

> My question: Can you indeed take an ally or retainer from another
> Methuselah's ash heap, playing Resurrection with Obeah? What

Obe: Yes. Val: No. (card text)
